title: The Layout Change
brief: Meridian Logistics plans to re-slot 600 pick locations over a weekend to cut travel time. Change request LC-12 goes for approval on Wednesday. Warehouse safety review is handled separately. You have 12 visit points to assess the quality aspects of the change.

actions.label: General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: Stock count plan after the move
Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: LC-12 states purpose, scope, and approvers.
Re-slotting plan lists each location move.
System update plan loads new locations on Monday at 6 a.m., after physical moves end on Sunday night; picks in between would use old locations (plan step 7).
evidence.whyItMatters: Identification of location must stay accurate throughout.

evidence.text: Customer storage terms ST-3 require 2 customers' goods to stay in temperature-monitored aisles; the plan moves them to aisle 22, which has no logger.
evidence.whyItMatters: Customer requirements on storage must be met.

evidence.text: No stock count is planned after the move (plan section 9 blank).
evidence.whyItMatters: Verifying stock after a move confirms identification.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask how the result will be verified.

evidence.text: Picker briefing plan BP-2 is a notice on the board.
evidence.whyItMatters: A fuller briefing would help adoption.

evidence.text: Pick instructions PI-9 show old location codes; no revision planned.
evidence.whyItMatters: Documents must be updated with the change.

evidence.text: Location labels for the 600 new locations are printed in one batch; plan step 5 has no check that each label matches its system code.
evidence.whyItMatters: Location identification must be verified, or picks go to the wrong place.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask how new labels are checked against the system.

evidence.text: Label stock for the move was delivered on order PO-3301 and checked on receipt.
New aisle signs are printed in a new font.

options: Approve with conditions: system update in step with moves, keep monitored goods in monitored aisles, stock count after the move, updated instructions, and a briefing
Approve and fix issues as they arise
decisions.rationale: The benefit is kept once the gaps are closed.

containment: Block picking during the move window
correction: Revise the plan for system timing, customer terms, stock count, PI-9, and briefing
cause: The change template lacks system, customer, verification, and document prompts
corrective: Add these prompts to the layout change template
effectiveness: Measure pick errors for four weeks after the move

debriefText.found: You checked system timing, customer terms, verification, and documents.
debriefText.missed: Compare physical and system timing in any move.
debriefText.falseFinding: Fonts and the coffee machine are not findings.
